**Stable ID:** `DATA-05.05` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 05 Licensing, access, consent and rights

Record withdrawals, takedowns, deprecations and disputed rights as dated, sourced events that change publication state.

## Deliverables

- Withdrawal and dispute event model
- Publication-state transitions after withdrawal

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/SOURCE_RIGHTS.md`
- `docs/MAINTENANCE.md`
- `schemas/event.schema.json`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each withdrawal event cites an authoritative notice

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A withdrawn version cannot remain publishable
- [ ] Disputes are recorded without restating unverified allegations
- [ ] Validator enforces state transitions

## Non-goals

- Adjudicating rights disputes

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-05.05.T1` Define events
  - [ ] `DATA-05.05.T1.S1` Define withdrawal, takedown and deprecation events
  - [ ] `DATA-05.05.T1.S2` Define dispute records
- [ ] `DATA-05.05.T2` Define transitions
  - [ ] `DATA-05.05.T2.S1` Define publication-state changes
  - [ ] `DATA-05.05.T2.S2` Add state-transition validation

## Dependencies

- Blocked by `DATA-05.01` License identification and per-version rights
- Blocks `DATA-09.03`

## Review requirements

- Rights reviewer
- Editorial reviewer
- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.
